confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge through June 2026, projected to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; the midrange meal and accommodation anchors carry the widest ranges because summer rates vary. Cocktail and wine anchors were set partly from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 13 Oct 2026 value comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview; the page itself was not opened, a second search could not corroborate it, and no 14 Oct RBA figure was verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city was used. The basis is Central and Eastern European EU capitals with similar restaurant and hotel price levels, with Sofia as the closest price peer and Budapest as a higher-priced upper reference.
